meta.description: Registry for bounded explicit symbolic functional forms for admissibility-sensitive delta continuation systems.

delta_functional_entries.name: Explicit Delta Functional Form
delta_functional_entries.purpose: Represent bounded explicit symbolic functional forms for admissibility-sensitive delta continuation systems.

delta_functional_conditions.name: explicit_delta_functional_forms_remain_defined
delta_functional_conditions.description: The system must maintain formal symbolic expressions for the delta operator proposal logic.

delta_functional_conditions.name: multi_valued_delta_selection_remains_preserved
delta_functional_conditions.description: Functional forms must allow for the return of multiple concurrent continuation candidates.

delta_functional_conditions.name: delta_functional_updates_remain_admissible
delta_functional_conditions.description: Changes to the operator form under recursion must satisfy current admissibility constraints.

delta_functional_conditions.name: selection_ambiguity_does_not_force_operator_collapse
delta_functional_conditions.description: Tie-resolution or ambiguous metrics do not imply the removal of operator non-determinism.

delta_functional_conditions.name: orientation_sensitive_delta_forms_remain_detectable
delta_functional_conditions.description: The impact of frame orientation on the symbolic structure of delta must be formally trackable.

delta_functional_conditions.name: recursive_delta_updates_remain_bounded
delta_functional_conditions.description: Iterative modification of the functional form must stay within established stability limits.

delta_functional_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_delta_witness
delta_functional_conditions.description: Pruning within the functional domain must not eliminate all possible valid delta proposals.

delta_functional_conditions.name: delta_functional_instability_remains_detectable
delta_functional_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to register breakdown in symbolic form or operator closure.
